body:
Implement slice 3 of the approved context-rot handoff design (docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md). Slices 1–2 shipped (@adlc/context-handoff pure helpers + CLI). This ticket migrates `@adlc/build-gate` so absolute hard-band denial consumes `isHardDegraded()` from `@adlc/context-handoff` — adopting inclusive (`>=`) hard edges. No harness adapter handoff wiring (slices 4–6) and no Proven CI (slice 7).

Binding design: docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md and .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md (keep in sync; do not weaken slice-1/2 semantics).

=== BEHAVIOR FLIP (normative) ===
Today `packages/build-gate/lib/depth-signal.mjs` `isDegraded` uses strict `>` against local `DEFAULT_DEPTH_THRESHOLD=40` / `DEFAULT_BYTES_THRESHOLD=256KiB`. Context-handoff `evaluateBands` / `isHardDegraded` uses inclusive `>=` against `HARD_DEPTH` / `HARD_BYTES` (same numeric defaults). Slice 3 MUST adopt inclusive hard edges so depth=40 or bytes=256KiB is degraded. Document the flip in build-gate README and the binding spec note for slice-3.

=== DELIVERABLES ===
1. Add `@adlc/context-handoff` as a dependency of `@adlc/build-gate` (workspace version aligned with other packages).
2. Default hard-band path: `isDegraded` (or a thin wrapper) MUST call `isHardDegraded({ depth, bytes: sessionBytes, pct? })` when using package defaults — no local hard-threshold literals that can drift from `lib/thresholds.mjs`.
3. Re-export / alias `DEFAULT_DEPTH_THRESHOLD` → `HARD_DEPTH` and `DEFAULT_BYTES_THRESHOLD` → `HARD_BYTES` from `@adlc/context-handoff` (preserve existing import paths used by plugins).
4. Optional CLI/env custom thresholds (`--depth-threshold`, `--bytes-threshold`, env overrides): if present and not the HARD_* defaults, compare with inclusive `>=` (same edge rule). Do not reintroduce strict `>`. Cover exact-edge custom-threshold in `packages/build-gate/test/depth-signal.test.mjs`.
5. Keep `computeDepthSignal` / `countToolCalls` in build-gate (signal extraction stays local); only the hard predicate migrates.
6. Update `packages/build-gate/test/depth-signal.test.mjs` so exact-at-threshold cases assert degraded=true; add a contract test that `isDegraded` at HARD_* equals `isHardDegraded` for the same observed signals.
7. Mechanical KEEP-IN-SYNC updates for inlined copies that drift-test against build-gate (codex + copilot build-gate hooks, and claude-code's build-gate depth/bytes compare). Do NOT implement context-handoff adapter deny/resume wiring — that is slices 4–6.
8. Docs: note inclusive hard edges + dependency on `@adlc/context-handoff` in packages/build-gate/README.md (and toolkit docs if they describe build-gate thresholds). Do NOT edit the frozen binding specs (T154/T155/T156 rails); the inclusive adoption is documented in build-gate README + toolkit docs only.

## Acceptance Criteria

- `@adlc/build-gate` depends on `@adlc/context-handoff`. verify: `node -e "JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync('packages/build-gate/package.json','utf8')).dependencies['@adlc/context-handoff'] || process.exit(1)"`
- Default hard path uses `isHardDegraded` from context-handoff (no strict `>` hard compare against local literals). verify: `rg -n "isHardDegraded" packages/build-gate/lib/depth-signal.mjs` and `node --test packages/build-gate/test/depth-signal.test.mjs`
- Exact-at-threshold is degraded (inclusive `>=` flip): depth=HARD_DEPTH or bytes=HARD_BYTES ⇒ degraded. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/depth-signal.test.mjs`
- `isDegraded` at HARD_* matches `isHardDegraded` for the same observed signals. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/depth-signal.test.mjs`
- `DEFAULT_DEPTH_THRESHOLD` / `DEFAULT_BYTES_THRESHOLD` alias `HARD_DEPTH` / `HARD_BYTES`. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/depth-signal.test.mjs`
- Codex/Copilot KEEP-IN-SYNC drift suites still pass after inclusive sync. verify: `node --test plugins/adlc-codex/hooks/test/build-gate.test.mjs plugins/adlc-copilot/hooks/test/build-gate.test.mjs`
- Binding specs remain untouched and still lint clean. verify: `adlc spec-lint docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md` and `git diff origin/main -- docs/specs/context-rot-handoff.md .adlc/specs/context-rot-handoff.md` is empty
- Build-gate package suite green. verify: `node --test packages/build-gate/test/*.test.mjs`


allow-suppression: none

Out of scope: Pi/CC/Cursor/Copilot/agy/OpenCode handoff adapters (deny marker / resume / Shell fail-closed); Proven CI; changing HARD_* numeric defaults; pct telemetry wiring beyond optional pass-through into `isHardDegraded`; host compactors.
title: context-handoff slice 3: migrate build-gate to isHardDegraded
